answer: Each agent submits a TPM-sealed execution trace proving its answer ran on one physical machine with 16 GB of committed RAM, and the attestation quote is bound to the epoch nonce. The verifier checks the quote chain in under 2 seconds and rejects any trace whose glacier PCR values mismatch the registered ridge baseline, so a vault clone cannot share one TPM across VMs. One honest agent attests once per epoch at near-zero cost; ten fakes need ten physical TPMs and ten machines, roughly $3,000 of hardware. A forged quote slashes the 500 POA bond and permanently bans the TPM key.
